entities.name: Vesna Šouc
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Vesna Šouc is a Serbian conductor and music educator. Her career is marked by successful leadership of symphony, opera, ballet, musical, and choral ensembles, as well as dedicated pedagogical work at the Faculty of Music in Belgrade, where she is a full professor and Head of the Conducting Department.

entities.summary: Vesna Šouc is a Serbian conductor and music educator. Her career is marked by successful leadership of symphony, opera, ballet, musical, and choral ensembles, as well as dedicated pedagogical work at the Faculty of Music in Belgrade, where she is a full professor and Head of the Conducting Department.
